freeze_stage: Before reading GraphRegion.lean, GraphControls.lean, PureBridge.lean, audit/certificate.json, REPORT.md, or any existing review Python
representation: Positive integer heap vertices. Root 1; child-parent pairs (2i,i) and (2i+1,i). Vertex depth is bit_length-1. This representation is independently authored from the one-bit adjacency description in TARGET.md.
connectivity_route: Undirected raw edge list; adjacency closure inside each selected subset, using repeated reachability expansion. No prefix/path characterization used to choose connected sets.
region_route: For a proposed root r and each selected integer v, repeatedly divide v by 2 until reaching r; fail if it goes above r or a required intermediate is absent. Require root membership. Separately collect all minimum-depth vertices and demand uniqueness for connected sets.

enumeration.pass: Every nonempty connected support has exactly one minimum-depth vertex and satisfies the region route at that root; every region-route success is connected. All named expectations match exactly.
enumeration.precision: Exact integer and Boolean arithmetic; no statistical fit, tolerance or floating-point semantic comparisons.

failure: Stop and retain the first support/root counterexample on any frozen expectation mismatch or connected support violating the semantic condition.
scope: Finite independent model controls only. A pass is not a proof for arbitrary support and does not validate executable hull extraction, G2–G7, a faster rMAF bound, or novelty.
